t: Home - Full Life Arts
s: April 17, 2025 - I have worn many hats over the years, but I have always felt the call to create a full and meaningful life for myself. Creating mandala art, practicing SoulCollage®, and walking the labyrinth are some of the activities that have enriched my life.
